lead_raw_text:
The structure of Nd8Co4O16 (reduced formula Nd2CoO4) crystallizes in the cubic space group F-43m (No. 216), with 28 atoms per unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies octahedral Co centers coordinated by six O neighbors at 1.96 Å, while Nd centers show eight O neighbors at 2.378 Å; O centers appear in both four-vertex and octahedral environments. The geometric neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all 28 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing contacts include corner-sharing between Co octahedra and both corner- and face-sharing between Co octahedra and Nd 8-vertex coordination polyhedra.
